declined: You closed the Spotify permission screen before approving. Connect again and approve the permissions to finish.
noApp: Add your Spotify app before connecting your account.
noToken: Spotify did not send a new sign-in token. Open spotify.com/account/apps, remove access for your app, then choose Connect Spotify and agree again.
oauth: Spotify refused the sign-in. Check that the Client ID and Client Secret match your Spotify app, and that the redirect URI shown on this page is saved in that app. Then connect again.
state: The sign-in link expired or was replayed. Start the connect again.
store: The token could not be stored. Try again in a moment.
unconfigured: Spotify setup is unavailable on our side right now. Try again later. If it lasts more than a day, email support@itsbagelbot.com.
cost: Enter a whole number of points, at least 1.
cooldown: Enter a cooldown between 0 seconds and 7 days.
